name: Tissue-culture station
status_line: Supplier and interface are still open, so there is no protocol to show yet.
reaches: Not decided. The example uses a made-up stand-in: 1 JSON message per release, the adapter speaks first, the station acknowledges or refuses. A real adapter would wrap what the chosen supplier documents.
decoded_from: Nothing decoded and nothing to decode yet. The message format, the error name unknown_batch and the ids are invented for this stand-in (TODO_1: the real interface). The questions below come from the toolkit's APPROACH.md and PREFLIGHT.md.
steps: Does it have an external serial, USB or Ethernet port, so a teardown can be skipped? (plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:19-20)
Does the vendor PC app drive it over a link you can mirror and capture, 1 setpoint at a time? (plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:71-82)
Is there a Ready, Start and Stop remote connector you could use as a minimal first tier? (plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:22-43)
Which commands are read-only telemetry and which actuate, so you can arm them separately? (plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:3-6 and plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:45-51)
Can your software be the sole master with the vendor app closed? (plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:92-93)
Which limits and interlocks stay on the instrument, and can you stay out of its internals? (plr-reverse-engineer/APPROACH.md:5-6 and plr-reverse-engineer/PREFLIGHT.md:7-8)
scenario: Release 1 cell batch for seeding and check that the receiving worklist names that batch in every row. Batch and worklist ids are made up.
real: Nothing from an instrument: no supplier is chosen
simulated: The station, its known batches and its releases
The stand-in message format and its replies
not_checked: Any culture instrument or its interface
Whether a real station acknowledges releases at all
limits: lost_reply maps to a release sent with no acknowledgement: hold, never resend (stations/culture/drive.py:37-39).
device_error maps to the stand-in refusing the release with a made-up error name, unknown_batch (stations/culture/sim.py:37-38).
Nothing in PyLabRobot 182f92e is used here; the adapter is this example's own code.
